topic.title: Controllable Audio Generation and Interactive Speech Systems
topic.overview: This topic brings together audio synthesis, editing, segmentation, and spoken interaction. Generative methods learn compact audio representations and connect them to text or other conditions, while interactive systems must coordinate listening, speaking, and task execution. One diffusion approach addresses scarce paired data through prompt enhancement and generation in a spectrogram-derived latent space.
topic.whyItMatters: Producing convincing sound is only one requirement for useful audio systems. Users also need controllable content, responsive timing, and reliable behavior amid accents, noise, interruptions, and multi-turn tasks.
topic.evolution: The representatives extend from early speech and music learning to text-conditioned diffusion and instruction-based audio editing. Recent work includes streaming spatial audio and full-duplex agent benchmarks. These benchmarks separately examine task completion and conversational behavior, revealing capability gaps that clean synthesis evaluations would miss.
openQuestions: How can generation quality, interaction timing, and task reliability be evaluated together?
What representations support precise editing without changing unrelated audio content?

papers.title: Aligning Audio-Visual Joint Representations with an Agentic Workflow
papers.tldr: AVAgent repeatedly evaluates and edits audio to better match video, improving joint representations and downstream task performance.

papers.title: An eye for an ear: zero-shot audio description leveraging an image captioner with audio-visual token distribution matching
papers.tldr: Matching audio and image token distributions lets an image captioner describe audio, improving zero-shot audio captioning.

papers.title: AudioMarkBench: Benchmarking Robustness of Audio Watermarking
papers.tldr: AudioMarkBench evaluates audio watermark removal and forgery across diverse speech and attack settings, revealing weaknesses in current methods.

papers.title: CA-SSLR: Condition-Aware Self-Supervised Learning Representation for Generalized Speech Processing
papers.tldr: CA-SSLR conditions speech representations on language and speaker information, improving several speech tasks with fewer trainable parameters.

papers.title: Continual Audio-Visual Sound Separation
papers.tldr: ContAV-Sep reduces forgetting during continual sound separation by preserving learned semantic relationships between audio and visual information.

papers.title: CoVoMix: Advancing Zero-Shot Speech Generation for Human-like Multi-talker Conversations
papers.tldr: CoVoMix generates multi-speaker conversations with overlapping speech, interjections, and laughter through a coordinated token-to-audio pipeline.

papers.title: FINALLY: fast and universal speech enhancement with studio-like quality
papers.tldr: FINALLY combines adversarial training and WavLM-based perceptual guidance to achieve reported state-of-the-art speech enhancement at 48 kHz.

papers.title: Frieren: Efficient Video-to-Audio Generation Network with Rectified Flow Matching
papers.tldr: Frieren uses rectified flow matching and temporally aligned feature fusion to generate synchronized video audio, with distillation enabling few-step or one-step sampling.

papers.title: GTSinger: A Global Multi-Technique Singing Corpus with Realistic Music Scores for All Singing Tasks
papers.tldr: GTSinger provides multilingual professional singing, detailed technique annotations, realistic scores, and benchmarks for four singing tasks.

papers.title: Images that Sound: Composing Images and Sounds on a Single Canvas
papers.tldr: Two pretrained diffusion models jointly generate spectrograms that resemble prompted images and produce prompted sounds.

papers.title: Learning Spatially-Aware Language and Audio Embeddings
papers.tldr: ELSA jointly represents sound identity and spatial location, supporting audio-text retrieval, source localization, and direction changes through embedding arithmetic.

papers.title: Listenable Maps for Zero-Shot Audio Classifiers
papers.tldr: LMAC-ZS generates listenable explanations that aim to preserve the text–audio similarity patterns behind zero-shot audio classifications.

papers.title: M$^3$GPT: An Advanced Multimodal, Multitask Framework for Motion Comprehension and Generation
papers.tldr: M³GPT unifies multimodal motion tasks through a shared input vocabulary, text-based task connections, and generation directly in raw motion space.

papers.title: MoMu-Diffusion: On Learning Long-Term Motion-Music Synchronization and Correspondence
papers.tldr: MoMu-Diffusion combines aligned motion-music latent representations with diffusion generation to produce long, diverse, beat-synchronized sequences.

papers.title: RealMAN: A Real-Recorded and Annotated Microphone Array Dataset for Dynamic Speech Enhancement and Localization
papers.tldr: RealMAN supplies annotated real-world microphone-array recordings that improve evaluated speech enhancement, localization, and transfer to unseen arrays.

papers.title: SCOREQ: Speech Quality Assessment with Contrastive Regression
papers.tldr: SCOREQ uses triplet-based contrastive regression to improve how speech-quality predictors generalize across speech domains.

papers.title: Self-Taught Recognizer: Toward Unsupervised Adaptation for Speech Foundation Models
papers.tldr: STAR uses decoding-based token quality estimates to adapt speech models from unlabeled audio, reducing word error rates across diverse target domains.

papers.title: SLIM: Style-Linguistics Mismatch Model for Generalized Audio Deepfake Detection
papers.tldr: SLIM learns style-language dependencies in real speech to improve deepfake detection on unfamiliar data and help explain its decisions.

papers.title: SongCreator: Lyrics-based Universal Song Generation
papers.tldr: SongCreator uses a dual-sequence model and task-specific attention masks to generate and edit songs while independently controlling vocals and accompaniment.

papers.title: Structured Multi-Track Accompaniment Arrangement via Style Prior Modelling
papers.tldr: A two-stage style-based system turns lead sheets into coherent multi-track accompaniments with controllable structure and improved efficiency.

papers.title: Tell What You Hear From What You See - Video to Audio Generation Through Text
papers.tldr: VATT generates audio from video with optional text control and can suggest audio descriptions to guide generation.

papers.title: The iNaturalist Sounds Dataset
papers.tldr: iNatSounds provides 230,000 wildlife recordings and demonstrates useful audio-model pretraining despite having only one species annotation per recording.

papers.title: Towards Open Respiratory Acoustic Foundation Models: Pretraining and Benchmarking
papers.tldr: OPERA provides open respiratory-audio models and benchmarks, with specialized pretraining outperforming general-audio models on 16 of 19 evaluated tasks.

papers.title: UniAudio 1.5: Large Language Model-Driven Audio Codec is A Few-Shot Audio Task Learner
papers.tldr: UniAudio 1.5 encodes audio into a language model's vocabulary, enabling few-shot audio tasks with a frozen model in simple scenarios.

papers.title: Unified Speech Recognition: A Single Model for Auditory, Visual, and Audiovisual Inputs
papers.tldr: Unified training, pseudo-labeling, and self-supervised pretraining enable one model to achieve state-of-the-art LRS3 results across three speech-recognition input modes.

papers.title: A Variational Framework for Improving Naturalness in Generative Spoken Language Models
papers.tldr: A variational framework automatically enriches speech tokens with continuous attributes, producing speech continuations preferred by human raters.

papers.title: AGAV-Rater: Adapting Large Multimodal Model for AI-Generated Audio-Visual Quality Assessment
papers.tldr: AGAV-Rater scores generated audio-visual content across quality dimensions and selects preferred outputs, supported by a new evaluation dataset.

papers.title: ALMTokenizer: A Low-bitrate and Semantic-rich Audio Codec Tokenizer for Audio Language Modeling
papers.tldr: ALMTokenizer uses context across audio frames to produce compact, semantically informative tokens that improve audio understanding and generation.

papers.title: Audio Flamingo 2: An Audio-Language Model with Long-Audio Understanding and Expert Reasoning Abilities
papers.tldr: Audio Flamingo 2 combines specialized audio training with a small language model to improve audio reasoning and understanding of recordings up to five minutes.

papers.title: BinauralFlow: A Causal and Streamable Approach for High-Quality Binaural Speech Synthesis with Flow Matching Models
papers.tldr: BinauralFlow combines flow-matching generation with causal streaming to produce realistic binaural speech continuously.

papers.title: DMOSpeech: Direct Metric Optimization via Distilled Diffusion Model in Zero-Shot Speech Synthesis
papers.tldr: DMOSpeech uses distilled diffusion and direct metric optimization to generate speech faster while outperforming its teacher in reported evaluations.

papers.title: Do Not Mimic My Voice : Speaker Identity Unlearning for Zero-Shot Text-to-Speech
papers.tldr: Teacher-Guided Unlearning selectively suppresses designated voice identities in zero-shot speech synthesis while preserving quality for other speakers.

papers.title: Efficient Fine-Grained Guidance for Diffusion Model Based Symbolic Music Generation
papers.tldr: Fine-Grained Guidance steers diffusion-based symbolic music generation toward composers’ intentions, with theoretical and experimental support.

papers.title: Emotional Face-to-Speech
papers.tldr: DEmoFace uses facial emotion and identity cues to generate expressive speech with a discrete diffusion transformer.

papers.title: ETTA: Elucidating the Design Space of Text-to-Audio Models
papers.tldr: A systematic study of text-to-audio design choices yields ETTA, with improved benchmark results and handling of imaginative prompts.

papers.title: FLAM: Frame-Wise Language-Audio Modeling
papers.tldr: FLAM improves open-vocabulary sound localization through calibrated frame-wise audio-language training while retaining strong retrieval performance.

papers.title: Freeze-Omni: A Smart and Low Latency Speech-to-speech Dialogue Model with Frozen LLM
papers.tldr: Freeze-Omni adds low-latency speech input, speech output, and duplex dialogue to a language model whose parameters remain frozen.

papers.title: Generative Audio Language Modeling with Continuous-valued Tokens and Masked Next-Token Prediction
papers.tldr: Continuous-valued audio tokens and masked next-token prediction improve reported audio-generation metrics with fewer parameters than the compared AudioGen models.

papers.title: IMPACT: Iterative Mask-based Parallel Decoding for Text-to-Audio Generation with Diffusion Modeling
papers.tldr: IMPACT combines parallel masked decoding with continuous-space diffusion to improve text-to-audio quality while reducing generation latency.

papers.title: Long-Form Speech Generation with Spoken Language Models
papers.tldr: SpeechSSM generates multi-minute speech without text intermediates and introduces evaluation tools for sustained audio generation.

papers.title: MATS: An Audio Language Model under Text-only Supervision
papers.tldr: MATS uses pretrained audio-text alignment and text-only training to achieve competitive performance on multiple audio tasks.

papers.title: MoHAVE: Mixture of Hierarchical Audio-Visual Experts for Robust Speech Recognition
papers.tldr: MoHAVE routes audio-visual inputs through selected expert groups to scale robust speech recognition with limited computational overhead.

papers.title: Multi-band Frequency Reconstruction for Neural Psychoacoustic Coding
papers.tldr: MUFFIN uses perceptually guided frequency-band compression to improve audio reconstruction and provide useful representations for generative tasks.

papers.title: MuseControlLite: Multifunctional Music Generation with Lightweight Conditioners
papers.tldr: MuseControlLite uses positional information in lightweight conditioners to improve time-varying music control with fewer trainable parameters.

papers.title: NTPP: Generative Speech Language Modeling for Dual-Channel Spoken Dialogue via Next-Token-Pair Prediction
papers.tldr: NTPP learns dual-channel spoken dialogue through paired-token prediction, improving conversational behavior and reducing inference latency in reported evaluations.

papers.title: OmniAudio: Generating Spatial Audio from 360-Degree Video
papers.tldr: OmniAudio combines panoramic and perspective video features to generate spatial audio, supported by the new Sphere360 dataset.

papers.title: SING: Spatial Context in Large Language Model for Next-Gen Wearables
papers.tldr: SING combines single-microphone spatial sensing with speech and language models to recognize speech and infer speaker directions.

papers.title: SongGen: A Single Stage Auto-regressive Transformer for Text-to-Song Generation
papers.tldr: SongGen uses one autoregressive Transformer to generate controllable songs as mixed audio or separate vocal and accompaniment tracks.

papers.title: Sortformer: A Novel Approach for Permutation-Resolved Speaker Supervision in Speech-to-Text Systems
papers.tldr: Sortformer uses sorted speaker objectives to improve diarization and provide effective speaker supervision for multi-speaker transcription.

papers.title: Sounding that Object: Interactive Object-Aware Image to Audio Generation
papers.tldr: An object-aware diffusion model generates audio for user-selected image regions and improves alignment between selected objects and their sounds.

papers.title: Supervised Contrastive Learning from Weakly-Labeled Audio Segments for Musical Version Matching
papers.tldr: Weakly supervised segment learning and a revised contrastive loss improve matching of both whole musical tracks and short excerpts.

papers.title: Teaching Physical Awareness to LLMs through Sounds
papers.tldr: ACORN combines simulated physical acoustics and magnitude-and-phase audio encoding to teach language models to infer physical properties from sound.

papers.title: XAttnMark: Learning Robust Audio Watermarking with Cross-Attention
papers.tldr: XAttnMark combines cross-attention message retrieval and perceptually informed training to improve audio watermark detection, attribution, and robustness.

papers.title: Aligning What Matters: Masked Latent Adaptation for Text-to-Audio-Video Generation
papers.tldr: A learnable mask aligns only shared audio and video representations, improving synchronization and semantic consistency in joint generation.

papers.title: ARECHO: Autoregressive Evaluation via Chain-Based Hypothesis Optimization for Speech Multi-Metric Estimation
papers.tldr: ARECHO jointly estimates speech metrics through a dynamic prediction chain that models their dependencies and uses confidence to reduce errors.

papers.title: Audio Flamingo 3: Advancing Audio Intelligence with Fully Open Large Audio Language Models
papers.tldr: Audio Flamingo 3 combines unified audio encoding and staged training to deliver open speech, sound, and music reasoning with strong benchmark results.

papers.title: Audio Super-Resolution with Latent Bridge Models
papers.tldr: Latent bridge models use the input recording to guide audio super-resolution, supporting frequency-aware training and cascaded upsampling to 192 kHz.

papers.title: AudSemThinker: Enhancing Audio-Language Models Through Reasoning over Semantics of Sound
papers.tldr: AudSemThinker structures reasoning around sound semantics and pairs it with a curated dataset, improving performance across evaluated training settings.

papers.title: BlockDecoder: Boosting ASR Decoders with Context and Merger Modules
papers.tldr: BlockDecoder separates text context from audio merging and reuses context across token blocks, reporting roughly twice the decoding speed without performance loss.

papers.title: BNMusic: Blending Environmental Noises into Personalized Music
papers.tldr: BNMusic generates personalized, rhythmically aligned music that blends with environmental noise to make it less noticeable.

papers.title: BRACE: A Benchmark for Robust Audio Caption Quality Evaluation
papers.tldr: BRACE tests reference-free audio-caption evaluation and reveals weaknesses in detecting fine-grained mismatches and hallucinated content.

papers.title: CoVoMix2: Advancing Zero-Shot Dialogue Generation with Fully Non-Autoregressive Flow Matching
papers.tldr: CoVoMix2 directly generates multi-speaker speech with flow matching, improving reported quality, speaker consistency, and speed while supporting overlap and timing control.

papers.title: DAVE: Diagnostic benchmark for Audio Visual Evaluation
papers.tldr: DAVE tests audio-visual understanding with questions requiring both modalities and diagnostic categories that expose distinct failure modes.

papers.title: DeepASA: An Object-Oriented Multi-Purpose Network for Auditory Scene Analysis
papers.tldr: DeepASA uses iteratively refined sound-object representations to unify separation, recognition, and spatial audio estimation.

papers.title: E-BATS: Efficient Backpropagation-Free Test-Time Adaptation for Speech Foundation Models
papers.tldr: E-BAT adapts speech models without backpropagation, improving accuracy over forward-only baselines while using less memory than backpropagation-based methods.

papers.title: Efficient Speech Language Modeling via Energy Distance in Continuous Latent Space
papers.tldr: SLED uses energy distance to model continuous speech representations, simplifying the pipeline while delivering strong zero-shot and streaming synthesis.

papers.title: FocalCodec: Low-Bitrate Speech Coding via Focal Modulation Networks
papers.tldr: FocalCodec compresses speech into a single binary codebook at low bitrates while retaining useful semantic and acoustic information.

papers.title: Go witheFlow: Real-time Emotion Driven Audio Effects Modulation
papers.tldr: witheFlow is a proof-of-concept system that uses biosignals and audio features to adjust musical effects during live performance.

papers.title: Interactive Artistic Text-To-Voice: Tungnaá and Bla Blavatar vs Jaap Blonk
papers.tldr: Tungnaá supports low-latency, controllable text-to-voice synthesis for experimental vocal performance using artist-created training data.

papers.title: Jailbreak-AudioBench: In-Depth Evaluation and Analysis of Jailbreak Threats for Large Audio Language Models
papers.tldr: Jailbreak-AudioBench combines audio construction tools, curated examples, and model evaluations to support systematic research on audio jailbreak threats.

papers.title: Let Them Talk: Audio-Driven Multi-Person Conversational Video Generation
papers.tldr: MultiTalk binds separate audio streams to the correct people while preserving instruction following in conversational video generation.

papers.title: LeVo: High-Quality Song Generation with Multi-Preference Alignment
papers.tldr: LeVo combines joint and separate vocal-accompaniment representations with preference alignment to improve song quality, harmony, and instruction following.

papers.title: LibriBrain: Over 50 Hours of Within-Subject MEG to Improve Speech Decoding Methods at Scale
papers.tldr: LibriBrain provides over fifty hours of one participant's MEG recordings and shows that more within-subject data substantially improves speech decoding.

papers.title: Live Music Models
papers.tldr: Magenta RealTime and Lyria RealTime generate continuous music streams that users can steer during live creation.

papers.title: LUMIA: A Handheld Vision-to-Music System for Real-Time, Embodied Composition
papers.tldr: LUMIA converts camera-captured scenes and user-selected instrumentation into loopable music through a handheld, interactive workflow.

papers.title: MambaKit: Towards Modular Intelligence - Cognitive Scaffolding in Next-Generation Drum Synthesis
papers.tldr: MambaKit combines interpretable musical controls with neural drum synthesis, reporting high-quality audio and substantial memory efficiency.

papers.title: Massive Sound Embedding Benchmark (MSEB)
papers.tldr: MSEB provides an extensible eight-task framework for evaluating sound representations and exposes substantial room for auditory-model improvement.

papers.title: MEGADance: Mixture-of-Experts Architecture for Genre-Aware 3D Dance Generation
papers.tldr: MEGADance combines quantized motion representations and genre-aware experts to generate music-driven 3D dance with strong genre control.

papers.title: Mellow: a small audio language model for reasoning
papers.tldr: Mellow shows strong audio reasoning with a small model trained using ReasonAQA, approaching Qwen2 Audio's MMAU score with far fewer parameters and audio hours.

papers.title: Metis: A Foundation Speech Generation Model with Masked Generative Pre-training
papers.tldr: Metis learns from unlabeled speech through masked pretraining and adapts efficiently to five speech generation tasks.

papers.title: MMAR: A Challenging Benchmark for Deep Reasoning in Speech, Audio, Music, and Their Mix
papers.tldr: MMAR provides 1,000 curated, multi-step audio reasoning questions that expose limitations across a broad range of evaluated models.

papers.title: Model-Guided Dual-Role Alignment for High-Fidelity Open-Domain Video-to-Audio Generation
papers.tldr: MGAudio combines model self-guidance with an audiovisual encoder that both conditions and aligns generated sound, improving realism and video–audio coherence.

papers.title: MoME: Mixture of Matryoshka Experts for Audio-Visual Speech Recognition
papers.tldr: MoME shares expert knowledge across token compression levels to improve efficient, noise-robust audio-visual speech recognition.

papers.title: MoonCast: High-Quality Zero-Shot Podcast Generation
papers.tldr: MoonCast combines long-form speech modeling with scripts containing spontaneous speech cues to generate podcasts in unseen speakers' voices.

papers.title: 🎧MOSPA: Human Motion Generation Driven by Spatial Audio
papers.tldr: MOSPA pairs a spatial-audio-and-motion dataset with a diffusion model that generates realistic body movements conditioned on spatial sound.

papers.title: MRSAudio: A Large-Scale Multimodal Recorded Spatial Audio Dataset with Refined Annotations
papers.tldr: MRSAudio combines spatial recordings, synchronized video, motion trajectories, and detailed annotations to support spatial audio understanding and generation.

papers.title: Music Arena: Live Evaluation for Text-to-Music
papers.tldr: Music Arena gathers live listener comparisons of text-to-music systems to support a shared leaderboard and renewable preference data.

papers.title: OmniResponse: Online Multimodal Conversational Response Generation in Dyadic Interactions
papers.tldr: OmniResponse coordinates online speech and facial listener responses using timestamped text and controllable speech generation.

papers.title: OmniSync: Towards Universal Lip Synchronization via Diffusion Transformers
papers.tldr: OmniSync uses mask-free diffusion editing and adaptive audio guidance to improve lip synchronization across real and AI-generated videos.

papers.title: OmniTalker: One-shot Real-time Text-Driven Talking Audio-Video Generation With Multimodal Style Mimicking
papers.tldr: OmniTalker jointly generates speech and talking video from text, mimicking audio and facial styles at a reported 25 frames per second.

papers.title: OpenOmni: Advancing Open-Source Omnimodal Large Language Models with Progressive Multimodal Alignment and Real-time Emotional Speech Synthesis
papers.tldr: OpenOmni uses progressive multimodal alignment and preference-trained speech generation to improve cross-modal performance and deliver real-time emotional speech.

papers.title: ProGress: Structured Music Generation via Graph Diffusion and Hierarchical Music Analysis
papers.tldr: ProGress combines discrete diffusion, hierarchical musical analysis, and user controls to support coherent, interpretable music generation.

papers.title: Robust Distortion-Free Watermark for Autoregressive Audio Generation Models
papers.tldr: Aligned-IS improves audio watermark detection by treating clustered tokens equivalently to counter retokenization mismatch.

papers.title: SALMONN-omni: A Standalone Speech LLM without Codec Injection for Full-duplex Conversation
papers.tldr: SALMONN-omni uses a standalone speech model with learned speaking–listening transitions to improve full-duplex conversation without codec tokens.

papers.title: SAO-Instruct: Free-form Audio Editing using Natural Language Instructions
papers.tldr: SAO-Instruct edits existing audio from free-form language instructions and generalizes to real-world clips and unseen requests.

papers.title: Shallow Flow Matching for Coarse-to-Fine Text-to-Speech Synthesis
papers.tldr: Shallow Flow Matching starts speech refinement partway along a generation path, improving naturalness and accelerating inference with adaptive-step solvers.

papers.title: SongBloom: Coherent Song Generation via Interleaved Autoregressive Sketching and Diffusion Refinement
papers.tldr: SongBloom interleaves autoregressive musical sketching with diffusion refinement to improve full-song coherence and sound quality.

papers.title: StreamFlow: Streaming Audio Generation from Discrete Tokens via Streaming Flow Matching
papers.tldr: StreamFlow combines causal flow-matching training and a revised diffusion transformer to generate high-fidelity audio streams from discrete tokens.

papers.title: ‘Studies for’ : A Human-AI Co-Creative Sound Artwork Using a Real-time Multi-channel Sound Generation Model
papers.tldr: Studies for uses Evala’s past sound artworks to generate live eight-channel audio, exploring an archive that preserves style while creating new sounds.

papers.title: TaDiCodec: Text-aware Diffusion Speech Tokenizer for Speech Language Modeling
papers.tldr: TaDiCodec uses text-guided diffusion to produce compact speech tokens with single-stage training and strong reconstruction and generation results.

papers.title: Target Speaker Extraction through Comparing Noisy Positive and Negative Audio Enrollments
papers.tldr: Comparing noisy references with and without the target speaker improves single-channel speech extraction and accelerates training.

papers.title: The Ghost in the Keys: A Disklavier Demo for Human-AI Musical Co-Creativity
papers.tldr: Aria-Duet enables a pianist and generative model to exchange coherent musical phrases through a shared acoustic Disklavier piano.

papers.title: ThinkSound: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs for Audio Generation and Editing
papers.tldr: ThinkSound uses multimodal stepwise reasoning to guide video sound generation, object-focused refinement, and language-directed editing.

papers.title: Unbiased Sliced Wasserstein Kernels for High-Quality Audio Captioning
papers.tldr: A temporally informed Wasserstein kernel improves the reported quality of audio captions, cross-modal retrieval, and audio reasoning.

papers.title: Unifying Symbolic Music Arrangement: Track-Aware Reconstruction and Structured Tokenization
papers.tldr: A shared reconstruction objective and REMI-z tokenization let one symbolic-music model handle diverse arrangement tasks and outperform task-specific systems.

papers.title: VITA-Audio: Fast Interleaved Audio-Text Token Generation for Efficient Large Speech-Language Model
papers.tldr: VITA-Audio generates multiple audio tokens per forward pass, reducing startup latency and reporting three- to fivefold faster inference at 7B scale.

papers.title: Watch and Listen: Understanding Audio-Visual-Speech Moments with Multimodal LLM
papers.tldr: TriSense combines visual, audio, and speech evidence through query-dependent weighting, supported by a dataset of over two million samples.

papers.title: Word-Level Emotional Expression Control in Zero-Shot Text-to-Speech Synthesis
papers.tldr: WeSCon uses self-training to add word-level emotion and speed control to zero-shot speech synthesis without annotated within-sentence transition data.

papers.title: ZeroSep: Separate Anything in Audio with Zero Training
papers.tldr: ZeroSep repurposes pretrained text-guided audio diffusion models for source separation through inversion and denoising, without task-specific training.

papers.title: A Semantically Consistent Dataset for Data-Efficient Query-Based Universal Sound Separation
papers.tldr: Hive improves sound-separation data efficiency by building synthetic training data from high-purity, single-event audio segments.

papers.title: AG-REPA: Causal Layer Selection for Representation Alignment in Audio Flow Matching
papers.tldr: AG-REPA improves audio representation alignment by supervising layers according to their measured causal contribution to generation.

papers.title: AgentSteerTTS: A Multi-Agent Closed-Loop Framework for Composite-Instruction Text-to-Speech
papers.tldr: AgentSteerTTS combines acoustic-example retrieval, speech synthesis, and feedback agents to improve control over composite speech instructions.

papers.title: Alethia: a Foundational Encoder for Voice Deepfakes
papers.tldr: Alethia uses continuous prediction and generative audio pretraining to improve voice deepfake detection, localization, and generalization.

papers.title: Ariadne’s Thread of LipSync: Unraveling Forgeries via Inconsistency between Lip Motions and Head Poses
papers.tldr: LipDA detects lip synchronization forgeries and identifies their generating models by analyzing inconsistencies in movement and audiovisual timing.

papers.title: AudioChat: Unified Audio Storytelling, Editing, and Understanding with Transfusion Forcing
papers.tldr: AudioChat uses simulated dialogues and a unified training objective to generate, edit, and understand complex audio stories.

papers.title: AudioMosaic: Contrastive Masked Audio Representation Learning
papers.tldr: AudioMosaic uses efficient time–frequency masking for contrastive audio pretraining, producing transferable representations and improving audio perception in LLM integrations.

papers.title: AuTAgent: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Tool-Augmented Audio Reasoning
papers.tldr: AuTAgent learns when audio tools provide useful evidence, improving reasoning accuracy through selective tool use.

papers.title: AVI-Bench: Toward Human-like Audio-Visual Intelligence of Omni-MLLMs
papers.tldr: AVI-Bench tests joint audio-visual perception, understanding, and reasoning, revealing substantial limitations in current multimodal models.

papers.title: BAT: Better Audio Transformer Guided by Convex Gated Probing
papers.tldr: A probe that combines information across frozen audio-model layers guides the development of BAT, which achieves leading audio benchmark results.

papers.title: BEAT: Tokenizing and Generating Symbolic Music by Uniform Temporal Steps
papers.tldr: BEAT groups symbolic music into uniform time steps, improving generation quality, structural coherence, and efficiency in the reported evaluations.

papers.title: BFCL Audio: An Audio Function Calling Evaluation for Large Language Models
papers.tldr: BFCL Audio evaluates how reliably speech-based agents turn spoken requests into correct tool calls under varied conversational and acoustic conditions.

papers.title: Bridging the Stability-Expressivity Gap: Synthetic Data Scaling and Preference Alignment for Low-Resource Spoken Language Models
papers.tldr: Two self-alignment methods address the loss of speech expressivity that can accompany synthetic-data scaling in low-resource languages.

papers.title: CMI-RewardBench: Evaluating Music Reward Models with Compositional Multimodal Instruction
papers.tldr: CMI-RewardBench combines datasets, evaluation criteria, and reward models for music generated from text, lyrics, and audio instructions.

papers.title: CoCoEmo: Composable and Controllable Human-Like Emotional TTS via Activation Steering
papers.tldr: CoCoEmo steers internal TTS activations to compose emotions and control delivery even when it differs from the text’s emotional content.

papers.title: DiscoForcing: A Unified Framework for Real-Time Audio-Driven Character Control with Diffusion Forcing
papers.tldr: DiscoForcing generates real-time audio-responsive motion by balancing rapid adaptation to changing audio with long-term movement consistency.

papers.title: Do Audio LLMs Listen or Read? Analyzing and Mitigating Paralinguistic Failures with VoxParadox
papers.tldr: VoxParadox exposes audio models' reliance on transcript meaning, while adaptive audio-layer mixing and preference training improve attention to acoustic evidence.

papers.title: DreamID-Omni: Unified Framework for Controllable Human-Centric Audio-Video Generation
papers.tldr: DreamID-Omni unifies human-centered audio-video tasks while explicitly separating and binding character identities and voices.

papers.title: Dual-View Predictive Diffusion: Lightweight Speech Enhancement via Spectrogram-Image Synergy
papers.tldr: DVPD combines frequency-aware compression and visual spectrogram features to enhance speech with substantially fewer parameters and computations.

papers.title: EchoingPixels: Aliasing-Resistant Joint Token Reduction for Audio-Visual LLMs
papers.tldr: EchoingPixels combines joint audio-visual token selection with sampling-aware positional encoding to retain comparable performance using 5–20% of tokens.

papers.title: Evaluating and Rewarding LALMs for Expressive Role-Play TTS via Mean Continuation Log-Probability
papers.tldr: MCLP uses speech continuation likelihood as a proxy for stylistic consistency and an effective training reward for role-play speech generation.

papers.title: FoeGlass: Simple In-Context Learning Is Enough for Red Teaming Audio Deepfake Detectors
papers.tldr: FoeGlass uses black-box, diversity-guided language-model exploration to discover audio deepfake detector failures and generate data that improves detector robustness.

papers.title: From Inpainting to Editing: Unlocking Robust Mask-Free Visual Dubbing via Generative Bootstrapping
papers.tldr: X-Dub uses an inpainting model to generate training pairs for a mask-free visual dubber with improved synchronization and robustness.

papers.title: Hidden in Plain Tokens: Simply Robust, Gradient-Free Watermark for Synthetic Audio
papers.tldr: Grouping redundant audio tokens enables gradient-free watermarks with stronger reported detection and resistance to audio modifications.

papers.title: HyperPotter: Spell the Charm of High-Order Interactions in Audio Deepfake Detection
papers.tldr: HyperPotter models interactions among groups of audio features, improving deepfake detection on 11 of 13 test sets.

papers.title: JAEGER: Joint 3D Audio-Visual Grounding and Reasoning in Simulated Physical Environments
papers.tldr: JAEGER combines depth-aware vision and directional audio to improve three-dimensional spatial understanding in simulated environments.

papers.title: Learning Tight Rejection Boundaries without Negatives for Strict One-Class Audio Deepfake Detection
papers.tldr: CA-SOADD uses centroid-based constraints and boundary probes to improve audio deepfake detection while training strictly on real speech.

papers.title: LightAVSeg: Lightweight Audio-Visual Segmentation

papers.title: MECAT: A Multi-Experts Constructed Benchmark for Fine-Grained Audio Understanding Tasks
papers.tldr: MECAT pairs detailed audio tasks with a metric that rewards distinguishing information and penalizes generic descriptions.

papers.title: MedMosaic: A Challenging Large Scale Benchmark of Diverse Medical Audio

papers.title: MetaPerch: Learning from metadata for bioacoustics foundation models
papers.tldr: MetaPerch uses recording metadata as auxiliary supervision to enrich bioacoustic representations and support species identification across challenging domains.

papers.title: MusicDET: Zero-Shot AI-Generated Music Detection
papers.tldr: MusicDET learns only from real music and detects generated tracks through their likelihood under the learned distribution.

papers.title: Neural-Inspired Modeling of Auditory Selection and Compensation for Audio-Visual Speech Separation
papers.tldr: Neuro-SCNet improves audio-visual speech separation through explicit visual guidance, temporal alignment, and reliability-aware compensation.

papers.title: PHALAR: Phasors for Learned Musical Audio Representations
papers.tldr: PHALAR uses structured musical audio representations to improve stem retrieval accuracy and efficiency while capturing information useful for beats and chords.

papers.title: PhaseCoder: Microphone Geometry-Agnostic Spatial Audio Understanding for Multimodal LLMs
papers.tldr: PhaseCoder encodes multichannel audio and microphone coordinates into spatial tokens that enable localization and spatial audio reasoning across microphone layouts.

papers.title: Pianist Transformer: Towards Expressive Piano Performance Rendering via Scalable Self-Supervised Pre-Training
papers.tldr: Pianist Transformer uses large-scale self-supervised MIDI pretraining and note-level compression to improve expressive piano rendering with an editable workflow.

papers.title: Polyphonia: Zero-Shot Timbre Transfer in Polyphonic Music with Acoustic-Informed Attention Calibration
papers.tldr: Polyphonia uses acoustic guidance to focus zero-shot timbre edits on a chosen musical stem while preserving competitive accompaniment integrity.

papers.title: Query-Based Asymmetric Modeling with Decoupled Input–Output Rates for Speech Restoration
papers.tldr: TF-Restormer restores speech at independently chosen input and output rates by separating observed-band analysis from missing-band synthesis.

papers.title: ReGen: Hierarchical Multi-Prompt Representation Generation for Efficient Waveform Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: ReGen jointly models representations and waveforms to improve compressed-latent audio generation and support efficient text-to-speech.

papers.title: SALSA-V: Shortcut-Augmented Long-form Synchronized Audio from Videos
papers.tldr: SALSA-V generates long, synchronized video-conditioned audio with reference-audio control and high-quality sampling in as few as eight steps.

papers.title: SAM Audio: Segment Anything in Audio
papers.tldr: SAM Audio separates diverse sound sources using text, visual, or temporal prompts within one model.

papers.title: Scaling Behavior in Model Fine-tuning for Audio DeepFake Detection
papers.tldr: Audio deepfake detection performance and robustness scale differently, making larger models alone insufficient for reliable generalization.

papers.title: Scaling Transformers for End-to-End Discrete Audio Tokenization
papers.tldr: TAC learns a scalable Transformer audio tokenizer end to end, improving reconstruction and supporting strong speech generation and recognition.

papers.title: Self-Guidance: Enhancing Neural Codecs via Decoder Manifold Alignment
papers.tldr: Aligning decoder features for continuous and quantized audio improves reconstruction and enables a fourfold smaller codebook without fidelity loss.

papers.title: SONAR: Spectral-Contrastive Audio Residuals for Generalizable Deepfake Detection
papers.tldr: SONAR improves audio deepfake detection by learning how speech content and high-frequency residuals agree in genuine recordings and diverge in fakes.

papers.title: SonicMaster: Towards Controllable All-in-One Music Restoration and Mastering
papers.tldr: SonicMaster unifies music restoration and mastering with text-guided or automatic enhancement, improving measured quality and listener preference.

papers.title: Sparse Autoencoders for Interpretable Emotion Control in Text-to-Speech
papers.tldr: Sparse autoencoders reveal internal speech features that enable interpretable emotion induction and suppression without modifying backbone parameters.

papers.title: Sparse Tokens Suffice: Jailbreaking Audio Language Models via Token-Aware Gradient Optimization
papers.tldr: TAGO shows that updating a small subset of high-gradient audio regions can preserve strong jailbreak success across evaluated audio language models.

papers.title: SPEAR: A Unified SSL Framework for Learning Speech and Audio Representations
papers.tldr: SPEAR distills speech and general-audio teachers into one model, achieving leading SUPERB results and competitive HEAR performance.

papers.title: Spherical Procrustes Alignment for Reliable Medical Audio Diagnosis
papers.tldr: SPA combines normalized features with dynamically aligned class geometry to improve medical audio prediction and reliability without extra inference cost.

papers.title: STARCaster: Spatio-Temporal AutoRegressive Video Diffusion for Identity- and View-Aware Talking Portraits
papers.tldr: STARCaster combines identity-aware motion, speech synchronization, and viewpoint control in a unified talking-portrait video model.

papers.title: Stream RAG: Instant and Accurate Spoken Dialogue Systems with Streaming Tool Usage
papers.tldr: Stream RAG starts tool queries during user speech, improving spoken question answering while reducing latency by up to 57%.

papers.title: TMD-Bench: A Multi-Level Evaluation Paradigm for Music–Dance Co-Generation
papers.tldr: TMD-Bench evaluates whether jointly generated music and dance follow instructions, look and sound good, and synchronize rhythmically.

papers.title: Towards Streaming Synchronized Spatial Audio Generation via Autoregressive Diffusion Transformer
papers.tldr: SwanSphere combines streaming diffusion generation and multimodal spatial alignment to produce spatial audio from panoramic video and text.

papers.title: VocSim A Training-free Benchmark for Zero-shot Content Identity in Single-source Audio
papers.tldr: VocSim tests frozen audio embeddings without model training, finding strong cross-domain content structure alongside a low-resource speech retrieval gap.

papers.title: $τ$-Voice: Benchmarking Full-Duplex Voice Agents on Real-World Domains
papers.tldr: τ-Voice jointly evaluates task completion and realistic spoken interaction, revealing a substantial performance gap between tested voice agents and text capability.
